title: Run a command in an OrbStack VM
summary: Execute a single command inside a running OrbStack virtual machine without opening an interactive session. Useful for quick checks or scripts.

steps.explain: Run a specific command inside a virtual machine. Replace <VM_NAME> with the VM name and <COMMAND> with the command to run.

placeholders.name: VM_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the virtual machine.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command to execute inside the VM.
